note: Bradford County (FL) publishes its zoning map only as a static Box file (bradfordcounty.box.com) and PDFs; the county GIS access page lists roads, FDOT, FEMA flood and SRWMD land use layers but no zoning service. Starke's zoning map and future land use map are PDFs only; Lawtey, Brooker and Hampton handle their own zoning with no public GIS layer found. ArcGIS Online 'Bradford Zoning' item (8aa532a8...) is a Pennsylvania county dataset owned by a consultant, not Florida. No queryable zoning district polygon service found.
